description: This header defines interfaces and classes for managing Resource Element (RE) buffers in a wireless communication context, including read-only, read-write, static, dynamic, and modular buffer implementations with support for slices and external data views.

classes.name: re_buffer_dimensions
classes.description: Interface for accessing the dimension sizes of a Resource Element buffer.

classes.name: re_buffer_reader
classes.description: Read-only interface for Resource Element buffers, templated by resource element type.

classes.name: re_buffer_writer
classes.description: Read-write interface for Resource Element buffers, templated by resource element type.

classes.name: re_buffer_reader_view
classes.description: Read-only view class providing subspan access to a Resource Element buffer.

classes.name: re_buffer_writer_view
classes.description: Read-write view class providing subspan access to a Resource Element buffer.

classes.name: dynamic_re_buffer
classes.description: Resizable, dynamic implementation of a Resource Element buffer.

classes.name: static_re_buffer
classes.description: Fixed-size, static implementation of a Resource Element buffer with maximum slices and REs.

classes.name: modular_re_buffer_reader
classes.description: External data view implementation for RE buffers, with settable slices.

classes.name: modular_re_buffer
classes.description: External data view implementation for RE buffers, with support for external data and resizing.

methods.name: get_nof_slices
methods.description: Returns the number of slices in the buffer.

methods.name: get_nof_re
methods.description: Returns the number of resource elements in the buffer.

methods.name: get_slice
methods.description: Returns a span of resource elements for a specific slice.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to specified slices and REs (for dynamic and static buffers).

methods.name: set_slice
methods.description: Sets the data view for a specific slice (for modular buffers).
